Deployment architecture

API request flow

  1. Client HTTP request
  2. NGINX Reverse proxy
  3. FastAPI On Amazon EC2

NGINX forwards requests to FastAPI on EC2. The FastAPI process runs as a systemd service.

Web request flow

  1. Browser HTTPS request
  2. CloudFront Content delivery
  3. Amazon S3 Static files

Route 53 and ACM support a custom HTTPS domain. GitHub Actions publishes web updates to S3.

Data and authentication services

  • Cognito User sign in
  • Amazon RDS PostgreSQL
  • ElastiCache Redis

Cognito handles authentication. PostgreSQL and Redis run on AWS managed services.
